answer: In 2023, total revenue generated across all product brands reached $5,416,118.93. GoldenCrust led all brands in revenue generation with $1,237,536.46, followed closely by CreamyFarm with $1,116,963.60. CrunchTime recorded the lowest revenue for the year at $452,267.33.
prompt: Show total revenue by product brand for 2023 as a bar chart
sql_query:
SELECT 
    p.brand, 
    SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue 
FROM sales s 
JOIN products p ON s.SKU_Coded = p.SKU_Coded 
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023 
GROUP BY p.brand 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
visualization_goal: Bar chart showing total revenue per brand for 2023, ordered from highest to lowest
